title: POST /api/v1/ticket/{id}/accept and /reject (request body)
description: An accept needs the full 40-character submitted review head and notes; a reject needs the sha and a reason. Operator only; the server gate is review_verdict.refuse, the same as atm accept / atm reject: the author can never accept their own work, and the sha must be the submitted head.

notes.description: accept: why this artifact is accepted (required by the gate)

reason.description: reject: what is wrong (required by the gate)
